nodes.description: Payable receive() fallback that accepts incoming ETH without any checks.
External function taking an arbitrary address and delegatecalling into it with encoded signature finesse(address).
Caller-supplied address used as the delegatecall target, fully attacker-controlled.
delegatecall to an unvalidated, caller-provided address, executing untrusted code in the context (and storage) of Bait.

edges.reason: bait unconditionally forwards execution to delegatecall on the attacker-supplied address with no access control or target validation.
The parameter _pickpocket flows directly into the delegatecall target, letting the caller choose arbitrary code to run in Bait's context.
bait receives the _pickpocket parameter supplied by the external caller and uses it as the callee address.

normalization_plan.reason: The parameter _pickpocket is only used as the target of the delegatecall; it should be normalized into the unsafe delegatecall operation it directly feeds.
